ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into child care fraud, including the MiLEAP program in Michigan and other similar programs across the country.
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in the US?
How do these programs impact families and children?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and abuse of power, and to bring about meaningful change for families and children. By following the money and analyzing data, we can uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable.
